info.desc: Vivid is Living Colour's debut album, which was released on May 3, 1988. The band was discovered by Mick Jagger while playing a show at the legendary punk club CBGB's in 1987. Although they were considered "unique" by the mainstream media, they attacked the Eurocentrism and racism of America with their music. The fact that Living Colour is an all-black heavy metal band drew much attention to the band and the album, which contained three singles and became one of the most popular albums of 1988, reaching #6 on the Billboard 200 and certified double platinum by the RIAA. podcast.body: Released in 1988, Living Colour's debut album was a groundbreaking "eye opening, ear opening, mind expanding experience" for many listeners. It masterfully blended diverse genres including metal, punk, soul, jazz, and rap, earning them recognition as MTV heroes and multiple Grammy Awards. "In 1988, they released a debut album entitled Vivid, and for many, this was an eye opening, ear opening, mind expanding experience."
